name: agent.github
description: Inspect and test the GitHub App connected to a persistent Jait agent. Each agent authorises as its own App bot identity instead of the user's personal account. Actions: status (list connections or one agent's connection), instructions (how to connect an App and the webhook URL to paste into GitHub), test (mint a token and verify it reaches GitHub). Use agent.github.token to obtain working credentials for a task. The App private key is never returned.

examples: Is my developer agent connected to GitHub?
How do I connect a GitHub App to my reviewer agent?
Test the reviewer agent's GitHub connection

agentId.description: Agent profile id. Omit to list every agent connection for the user.

name: agent.github.token
description: Mint a short-lived GitHub installation token for a persistent agent's own GitHub App, so this agent's commits, pushes and pull requests are authored by its App bot instead of the user. Returns the token plus its expiry; pass it as GH_TOKEN to git/gh commands. Use this on demand per task and never store it long-term.

examples: Get me a token so I can push as the developer agent

agentId.description: Agent profile id whose App identity to mint. Omit inside that agent's own thread.
